name: consult-mcp
description: MCP server that wraps the Codex, Antigravity, Gemini and Claude CLIs plus any local OpenAI-compatible runner (llama-swap, Ollama, LM Studio, llama-server, vLLM) as headless tools. Provides single-shot asks, multi-turn chat with on-disk session relay, and a Borda-count council tournament.

scripts.//: test = free/offline. test:local = free, needs a local runner. The rest cost real API tokens.
scripts.test: node unit-test.js && node delegate-test.js && node smoke-test.js
